overview: The Medford Community Preservation Committee recommended funding for an archaeological survey small grant and four remaining FY26 capital projects, including Tufts Park field lighting and Shiloh Baptist Church window restoration. The committee also evaluated its application review process and set its tentative calendar for 2026.

items.title: Brooks Estate Archaeological Survey Small Grant Application
items.summary: The committee recommended approval of a $10,000 small grant application for a desktop archaeological survey of the Brooks Estate and adjacent cemetery land, conditioned on coordination with property stakeholders and conservation restriction holders.

items.title: FY26 Application Deliberations and Budget Review
items.summary: The committee reviewed available fund balances and reserves before taking final votes on four remaining FY26 funding requests.

items.title: World War II Angel of Victory and Peace Fountain Restoration
items.summary: The committee recommended $167,800 in CPA funding for the fountain restoration project, with a condition requiring a long-term maintenance plan.

items.title: Cross Street Cemetery Monument Restoration Phase Two
items.summary: The committee recommended $126,500 in funding to restore monuments and repair the perimeter wall at Cross Street Cemetery.

items.title: Shiloh Baptist Church Window Restoration Phase Two
items.summary: After a proposal to increase the grant amount was defeated, the committee recommended the requested $150,000 for phase two window restoration with conditions requiring schematic drawings and carpentry cost estimates before disbursement.

items.title: Tufts Park Field Lighting Improvements
items.summary: The committee recommended $432,000 for Field 2 lighting improvements at Tufts Park, subject to conditions governing future equipment reuse or repayment if park renovations occur.

items.title: Application Process Review and 2026 Meeting Calendar
items.summary: Members reviewed feedback on the annual grant application cycle, discussed public outreach for open space priorities, and established the 2026 meeting schedule.
